posts.name: Pradheepa
posts.cooked: Hi , I have not cleared OPPE exam this term. Will i be able to appear for OPPE alone in next term? Kindly advise.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Yes, you can only appear for OPPE, if eligible (but have to do BPTs in the next term)

You have two choices

  1. Re-OPPE - give OPPE only & complete the course (fee - check image below) subject to passing in the course (Total score >= 40) & giving end term. Must do BPTs even if you got 100 in this term. BPTs are for OPPE eligibility. For BPTs, May term’s score will be taken into account.

Note - Option 1 only possible if you are not doing repeat oppe in this term.

  1. Repeat the entire course

image782×686 18.4 KB

posts.name: Jb Anmol
posts.cooked:
very helpful,
If I pass the course this term (May 2025), can I apply in January 2026 or any other term in diploma level, only to improve my OPPE score? Just for OPPE, right?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: REOPPE can only be done in consecutive term.

posts.name: Jb Anmol
posts.cooked: Sir, I have passed both the OPPE and the End Term exam, and my current grade is B. I would like to apply for OPPE improvement in the September term, but I did not find any option for this during registration. Could you please guide me on how to proceed?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If you have passed the course you cannot do OPPE improvement.
